title: Degraded checkout — recommendation-service saturating outbound DB calls
symptoms: threads waiting to acquire a database connection
p95 and p99 latency climbing together
observed_signals: pool stats showed checked-out connections near max with a wait queue
connection wait time increased before error rate peaked
latency jumped by more than 10x while CPU stayed only moderately higher

timeline.event: p95 latency on recommendation-service began climbing
connection wait logs appeared on recommendation-service
error rate returned toward baseline after the change

contributing_factors: organic traffic plus retries exceeded the configured pool
resolution: raised Hikari/Knex/SQLAlchemy max pool size after reviewing concurrency
added dashboards for wait_count and acquire timeout rate
lessons_learned: alert on pool utilization and acquire timeouts, not only on 5xx
treat connection-wait logs as a first-class signal during latency incidents
